# Overview {.unnumbered}
## Purpose {.unnumbered}

The goal of this book is to bring together the various visualization tools that may not have been designed for bioarchaeology, but proliferate the discipline.

## Sections {.unnumbered}

The book is divided into two main parts:

1.  Introduction to R Visualizations
2.  Discipline specific Visualizations
